title: Qualify long range fill and portable Guava search on release bytes
description: Rebuild the source-frozen int and long checkers and run them with Landlock on the same Temurin 21 range-fill request. Bind four earlier and relocated Guava operations to their original class and support bytes. Recheck every earlier Guava and range control, run the physical release grids, and record the post-JDK refusal on the fastutil public range entry.
expected: The frozen int checker declines long fill, the successor establishes its full-width frame, all four Guava entries transfer on the original checker, and staled evidence is rejected.
